rule: **C1 Symbol identity.** Every definition has exactly one ID. Every reference to it uses that ID: a call in the defining file, through an import, a re-export, an alias or a `require` binding. A definition that edges reach is listed in `nodes`, including body-less member declarations of scanned types (interface/trait/protocol methods) and module-level bindings that hold a function. A high edge's callee is always in `nodes`. Names resolve in definition order through local bindings, local opens, enclosing structures and their opens/includes, module aliases (`module F = Filegen.Make (P)`) and dune library wrappers (`Functoria.DSL`); then Stdlib (`Stdlib.invalid_arg`), the innermost external local open, the one external open (medium); `List.length` medium; applying a parameter is unknown.
notes: C1: `geom.area` is called bare in its own file (`scaled`), bare through `open Geom` in report.ml, and qualified as `Geom.area` in main.ml; all three use the one ID `geom.area` (file basename), high. `let open Geom in perimeter r` and `Geom.(scaled r)` are local opens of a scanned module: `geom.perimeter`, `geom.scaled`. `Printf.sprintf` is external and qualified: medium.
